knownBehavior: WITH USER_MODE exposes the full set of access errors through QueryException.getInaccessibleFields(). Exact expanded map contents and diagnostic text below are not yet native observations.
scope: Single-argument Database.query with four flat selected fields, a bare Id IN bind, one ascending text-field ordering, and explicit WITH USER_MODE. No relationship, aggregate, scope overload, handle, five-field, or security-enforced expansion.
helperMetadata: Actual publicly supplied query-helper and query-builder metadata is API 63.0. Capture matched 62/67/68 and helper63/caller62/67/68 separately.
environmentControls: Resolve a Minimum Access - Salesforce profile explicitly; record its ID and read permissions. Missing profile is a fixture failure, not an object-denial answer.

Deploy a new owned permission set granting Account read and Account.AccountNumber read without AnnualRevenue read. Assign it to an owned inserted test user; record object/field describe controls under that user.
Record permission-set metadata and assignment, schema field types, helper/caller source metadata, org multicurrency flag, actual query text, and selected field count.

The supplied public snapshot contains no profile or permission-set metadata files although its setup expects an installed account-read permission set. Do not infer or manufacture those grants from its name.

rows.query: SELECT AccountNumber, AnnualRevenue, Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN :ids WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY Name ASC NULLS FIRST
rows.helperSource: public class ProjectionAccessHelper {public static String observe(Set<Id> ids){Map<String,Object> out=new Map<String,Object>{'stage'=>'query'};try{List<SObject> rows=Database.query('SELECT AccountNumber, AnnualRevenue, Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN :ids WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY Name ASC NULLS FIRST');out.put('size',rows.size());out.put('querySucceeded',true);}catch(QueryException e){out.put('querySucceeded',false);out.put('exceptionType',e.getTypeName());out.put('exceptionMessage',e.getMessage());out.put('inaccessibleFields',e.getInaccessibleFields());out.put('mapIsNull',e.getInaccessibleFields()==null);}return JSON.serialize(out);}}
